purpose: Canonical room references for Nyx. One entry per environment location_id. The text anchors stay in the story locks; this file names the ONE approved image each room is judged against.
rule: A room/environment continuity PASS is blocked unless the room has a registered reference_asset whose file exists and whose sha256_16 still matches. Only exception: the room's establishing_story, whose slide establishing_slide creates the reference and whose later slides are judged against that approved slide. Enforced by room_references.gate(), called from story_continuity.qa_slide and episode_manifest.qa_decide.
register_with: python3 room_references.py register <location_id> <asset_path> <registered_by> -- human/executor bookkeeping only, after the founder confirms that file is the approved room master. Zero cost, local write.

nyx_loft_star_atlas.summary: Nyx's own city attic/loft apartment at night -- the canonical cinematic-loft world-bible setting (warm amber lamp+candle light against cool blue city/moon window light, dark wood, celestial textiles, star chart, books, restrained greenery, a cat), NOT the plain Star-Map bedroom and NOT the earlier illustrated high-fantasy attic. Identical anchor set across every slide of this story.
